profiles.title: Stability — safe & well-supported
profiles.description: Verified tier: switch GPU driver off nouveau via ubuntu-drivers (highest-leverage change), keep swap present for systemd-oomd, expect ManagedOOMSwap=auto, keep min_ttl_ms at 0. inotify/swappiness values are unverified consensus — see report.
